subject: TEST RESULT: host-local exact-token interaction lease passes adversarial model
body: Android-free Kotlin model compiled and passed. Deterministic cases: 6/6 PASS covering exact activation, opening-live pass-through, terminal revocation, stale release isolation, owner-rejected attempt, and remap release-before-replacement. Fixed-seed adversarial validation: 10,000 host runs x 40 randomized exact/stale activation/revoke operations; 0 terminal-revocation invariant violations. Core invariant: once a host-local lease is REVOKED, shouldConsumeTouch() can never become true again.
